cases.note: A write that attempts nothing (or whose attempts match nothing) keeps every candidate and the evidence: the lossless save before a Generate.
A promoted candidate leaves the envelope; a candidate still pending keeps the evidence, so a later Generate can promote it.
The write promoted the last pending candidate: the evidence goes (OV-1132).
A rejected candidate is not pending and is not retried: it stays, and the evidence goes.
Without a promotion the evidence stays, next to a rejected candidate too.
Current derived entries supersede the evidence (OV-1129); the candidates stay.
Evidence without candidates or current derived entries stays.
The same evidence next to current derived entries goes.
Promoting the last candidate of a Session without evidence writes neither.
